language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hi! I’m Chiara, I live here on Cyprus. Cyprus is an island, so we have lots of wind here. What do you know about wind?
Did you know wind can be changed into electricity? This can be done for example, by a windmill. The wind makes the blades of the windmill turn.
The turning of the blades make the generator in the wind mill turn and while turning, it generates electricity. That’s great, isn’t it? Let’s see what else we can find out about wind!
Wow! Maybe we can even use the wind to surf on the water. That would be great!

Do you know how electricity is made by wind power?
When the wind blows against the rotor blades of the mill, the rotational energy of the rotor blade is used to generate electricity by turning the generator.

Nacelle is a casing that holds the generator, electronic control unit, yaw controller and brakes. The tower supports the rotor blade and the Nacelle. It also keeps the turbine parts high above the ground!
